Class Theme

java.lang.Object
io.github.isoyigido.basic.gui.app.Theme
public final class Theme extends Object
Stores application appearance. Provides the method registerColorTheme(String, String...) to register color theme JSON files, and the method setColorTheme(String) to set the color theme from the registered color themes. The colors of set color themes can be accessed via getColor(String), which returns the corresponding color for the given color key.

  • Method Details

    • registerColorTheme

      public static void registerColorTheme(String directory, String... colorThemeNames)

      Loads and flattens the color theme JSON files at the given resource directory. Registers the flattened color themes under the given color theme names.

      The names of the JSON files should match the given color theme names (e.g., light.json, dark.json).

      Special cases:

      • Logs a warning and skips the color theme if no corresponding color theme file is found, or if the color theme file cannot be read
      Parameters:
      directory - the path to the directory that contains the color theme files relative to the resources folder (e.g., /app/themes/)
      colorThemeNames - the names of the color themes to be registered (e.g., light, dark)
      Throws:
      NullPointerException - if the input directory or colorThemeNames is null

    • parseHex

      public static Optional<Color> parseHex(String valueString)

      Parses the given String representation of a hexadecimal color value.

      Valid formats:

      • #RRGGBB(AA)
      • RRGGBB(AA)
      • 0xRRGGBB(AA)
      • 0XRRGGBB(AA)

      Note: The alpha channel (AA) is optional, and should be included after the RGB bytes if present. Both uppercase and lowercase hexadecimal letters (A-F and a-f) are accepted.

      Special cases:

      • Logs a warning and returns an empty Optional if the String representation of the hexadecimal value is invalid
      Parameters:
      valueString - the String representation of the hexadecimal color value
      Returns:
      an Optional containing the parsed Color, or an empty Optional if the String representation of the hexadecimal value is invalid

    • setColorTheme

      public static void setColorTheme(String colorThemeName)

      Sets the color theme to the given registered color theme.

      Sets the corresponding color for the color key "background" as the background color if present.

      Special cases:

      • Logs a warning and does nothing if the given color theme name is not registered
      Parameters:
      colorThemeName - the registered name of the color theme

    • getColor

      public static Color getColor(String key)

      Returns the corresponding color for the given color key.

      Example color key: menu.button.background

      Special cases:

      • Logs a warning and returns PLACEHOLDER_COLOR if no color theme has been set yet, or if the corresponding color is missing
      Parameters:
      key - the color key
      Returns:
      the corresponding color
      Throws:
      NullPointerException - if the input key is null
      See Also:
